# Sports Therapy

## individualized sports therapy

### Get back into the game you love!

Sports always bring the risk of injury, aches, and pains that can put you on the sidelines. At Doctors of Physical Therapy, we help athletes get back into the game. From professional MMA fighters to beginning softball outfielders, we understand sport and what your body needs to heal and strengthen. We will design an individualized treatment plan tailored to meet your goals. Our state-of-the-art techniques and hands-on care facilitate rapid recovery. We can work directly with you, your coach, and your physician for optimal return to play. Whether you’re recovering from injury or surgery or finally addressing that nagging ache or pain, we can help! We will restore your foundation to take your game to the next level!

## Some of our athletic partners:

- Eclipse Soccer
- Milwaukee Power Hockey
- Racine Raiders Football
- Rothwell MMA

![Sport Therapy DPT](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

## We have also worked with athletes from:

- Joffrey Ballet, Chicago, IL
- Poland Professional Ballet, Warsaw, Poland
- Strikers Soccer Club, St. Charles, IL
- NSA Soccer Club, Naperville, IL
- Illinois High School Association
- Big10 athletes

## Ready To Get Moving Again? Get A Appointment Now!

No need to wait any longer to start feeling better! Get signed up now for an appointment now to get back to the life you love!

[Schedule Now](https://members.drsofpt.com/dpt/welcome)
